description: Four units whose lossless extension states a frame of 20 bytes, less than its band data reach.
findings: past the 20 bytes of the frame

crosscheck.decode_error: Read past end of XLL frame

skip.ffprobe_bitrate: ffmpeg's lossless decoder sets the bit rate to 0 (dca_xll.c: avctx->bit_rate = 0), so ffprobe lists none
skip.ffprobe_profile: ffmpeg names the lossless profile when its decoder has decoded a frame (dca_xll.c), which it does not here, so ffprobe names the core's
skip.decode: ffmpeg's decoder refuses band data that runs past the frame's stated size (dca_xll.c: 'Read past end of XLL frame')
